prompt:
It's the first of the month and Brooke wants the leasing pipeline squared away - but honestly I think there's more going on than just stale deals. I've been splitting time between renewals and helping Sandra on intake, and between all the handoffs I'm not confident everything actually got followed through on.

Here's what's bugging me: one of the renewals kicking in this month had a maintenance issue at the unit a couple months back - damage that needed an outside vendor. I need to know if that actually got taken care of before the new lease started, because if the unit still has open repair work that's a problem on day one. Also make sure the repair cost didn't accidentally get charged to the tenant - that kind of thing should be on the property owner's side.

On top of that, we've got at least one vacancy from a non-renewal that should be turning over. I know there are other unit turns happening at the same property and I don't want anyone mixing up which unit is which - confirm the specific vacated unit has its own make-ready kicked off, not just that the property has turnover work going on in general. There's a whole summer turn cycle the team's been tracking and I need to know this unit is actually in that queue, not falling between the cracks. If nobody started it, get the PM and maintenance leads looped in so we don't lose vacancy days.

The financial side needs a check too - make sure what's been billed and collected matches what the CRM says the lease terms should be for every deal that closed recently.

And the referral piece: some of these deals came through outside partners, and every closed referral should have had a confirmation sent back. If any got missed in all the handoff shuffle, send it.

Post the full reconciled status in the leasing channel for Brooke and Sandra, and block time on my calendar next week to follow up on whatever's still open.
